name: Dumbbell Stability Ball Chest Press
steps: Sit on the ball with a dumbbell in each hand, then walk forward until the ball supports your head and upper back.
Lift your hips level with your thighs and hold the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells with control toward the outer sides of your chest with your elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press both weights straight back up until your arms are extended while keeping the ball steady beneath you.
tips: Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs continuously so your hips do not sag toward the floor.
Plant your feet wider than hip-width if you need extra lateral stability on the ball.
